description: This source file implements inverse trigonometric functions (asin, acos, atan) for rational number representations, including angle conversions and Taylor series approximations.

methods.name: ascalerat
methods.description: Converts rational angle values between radians, degrees, and gradians based on the angle type.

methods.name: _asinrat
methods.description: Calculates arcsine of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: asinanglerat
methods.description: Calculates arcsine of a rational number and converts the result to specified angle type.

methods.name: asinrat
methods.description: Computes arcsine of a rational number with domain checks and special handling near ±1.

methods.name: acosanglerat
methods.description: Calculates arccosine of a rational number and converts to specified angle type.

methods.name: _acosrat
methods.description: Calculates arccosine of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: acosrat
methods.description: Computes arccosine of a rational number with special cases for ±1.

methods.name: atananglerat
methods.description: Calculates arctangent of a rational number and converts to specified angle type.

methods.name: _atanrat
methods.description: Calculates arctangent of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: atanrat
methods.description: Computes arctangent of a rational number with domain handling for large values.
